annotations.title: Get dealer prices for a product

description: Current listed US dealer prices for one tracked bullion product, lowest first, with per-dealer stock status (in_stock vs out_of_stock / unavailable in dealers_unavailable). Sorted by price only: dealers marked "Partner" pay to list and never to rank. Only prices checked in the last 24 hours are returned. Never substitutes a different weight. Standard tool free; for a version fine-tuned or customized to your business, email for pricing via https://bullionpricecheck.com/contact/.

limit.description: Maximum number of dealers to return.

payment.description: bank = check/ACH/wire price (default); card = the dealer's listed credit card price.

product.description: Product slug from list_products (for example american-silver-eagle-1oz) or a name with its weight, such as "1 oz silver eagle". A name only matches a product of the same weight. If the product is not tracked, the tool returns an error naming the closest tracked products.

name: get_dealer_prices
